Name: Walkman
Author: Leeguanghui
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod allows you and your friends to enjoy music together in Stardew Valley[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Put the mod in the mods folder.Downloaded songs need to be placed in Mods\WalkmanMod\assets\songs，and the song format should be either ogg or wave.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Press the Tab key to open the song selection screen[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Need to install SMAPI[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Xu Jiali for helping me test the mod[/color]

Manifest.Name: 随身听 Walkman
Manifest.Description: 一个可以随身携带、随时更换背景音乐的物品：开局自带，按 Tab 键打开选歌界面。音乐文件放在本模组的 assets/songs 文件夹即可。
Manifest.Author: You
